widgetEase.title: Widget Ease
widgetEase.subtitle: Business Software
widgetEase.description: Widget Ease changes how businesses handle customer support. It's an AI chat widget you embed on your site, trained on your content so it can answer customers 24/7.
widgetEase.longDescription: The platform features a simple onboarding process for clients, allowing them to generate and install their widget in minutes. There's also an admin dashboard where businesses can customize the assistant's tone, upload documentation, monitor conversations, and analyze performance metrics.

joblizer.title: Joblizer
joblizer.subtitle: Job Matching Platform
joblizer.description: Skip the resume black hole. Joblizer connects job seekers and recruiters without relying on old ATS filters and keyword matching.
joblizer.longDescription: Create your profile once and let AI match you with jobs that fit. Features one-click applications, intelligent scoring, and detailed AI reports for both job seekers and employers. No more typing the same details into 100 applications, or getting filtered out by an ATS.

menulizer.title: Menulizer
menulizer.subtitle: Restaurant Technology
menulizer.description: Create digital menus in minutes. Customers scan a QR code, browse your menu and order straight from their phones.
menulizer.longDescription: Menulizer handles contactless dining from start to finish. It includes instant QR code generation, direct ordering from phones, multi-language support, and real-time order management. Restaurants manage menus and orders from one dashboard.

timeline.question: What's your typical project timeline?
timeline.answer: Project timelines vary based on scope and complexity. Simple websites take 2-4 weeks, while complex applications can take 2-6 months. Once we've talked through your requirements, we'll give you a detailed timeline.

international.question: Do you work with international clients?
international.answer: Yes. We work with clients worldwide, fully remote, and we're flexible with time zones and how you like to communicate.

solutions.question: What kind of solutions do you create?
solutions.answer: We build websites, mobile apps and business software. Our focus is software that's reliable, easy to use and helps your business grow.

support.question: Do you provide ongoing support?
support.answer: Yes, we offer maintenance and support packages to keep your application running smoothly. This includes updates, bug fixes, and feature enhancements.

studio.gameTagline: Our first title: a cozy farming & ranching sim
studio.gameDescription: Grow crops, raise and breed animals, keep bees, process your harvest, and run your own shop in a living economy.

meta.title: Devlizer Studio - Hayloop
meta.description: Hayloop by Devlizer Studio: a cozy farming and ranching sim. Grow crops, raise and breed animals, keep bees, process goods, and run your own shop. Wishlist it on Steam.

hero.description: Grow a small plot into a thriving agricultural business. Plant and tend crops, raise animals, keep bees, process your harvest into valuable goods, open your shop, and automate your farm as it grows, all on your way to breeding prized horses.

features.title: Every system
features.description: Crops become animal feed, animals provide goods and fertilizer, fertilizer boosts your crops, and everything can be processed, sold, or put back into the ranch.

farming.title: Farming
farming.description: Start from the ground up: prepare the land, plant a wide variety of crops, and tend them through every stage of growth. Water, fertilize, and keep weeds under control to get the best harvests.

livestock.title: Livestock & Breeding
livestock.description: Raise animals, feed them well, and keep them healthy. Each one has its own needs, products, and genes. Bred animals inherit genes from their parents, and better genes mean better produce and higher prices.

beekeeping.title: Beekeeping
beekeeping.description: Honey is essential for many recipes. Build hives, upgrade them with more supers, and grow your worker bees to produce more honey.

production.title: Production Chains, Crafting & Cooking
production.description: Build processing stations to turn raw materials into higher-value goods. Mill, bake, cook, compost, craft, and more. Each new station opens up new products and recipes.

villagers.title: Villagers & Offers
villagers.description: Explore the valley and knock on villagers' doors to offer your products. They may accept or refuse, so find out what each of them wants.

business.title: Run Your Own Business
business.description: Rent a storefront, place shelves, and stock them with your own products. Serve customers quickly to build your reputation and bring more of them in.

economy.title: A Real Economy
economy.description: Prices rise and fall with the market. Keep an eye on the charts and sell at the right moment, since villagers, your store, and vendors are all affected by the economy.

cta.title: Help us grow
cta.description: Wishlisting on Steam is the best way to support the game and get notified the moment it launches.
